title: Lesson 2 Checkpoint — Superlatives
description: Show what you learned about superlatives. You need at least 4 out of 5 correct to pass.
canDo: I can use superlatives to say something is #1 in a group.

questions.question: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: This is the best pizza in town.
This is the best pizza in town.
This is the best pizza in town.
questions.answer: This is the best pizza in town.
questions.explanation: Correct pattern for Superlatives: The + -est (the oldest) or the most + adj (the most interesting).

questions.question: Complete: This ___ the best pizza in town.
questions.explanation: The + -est (the oldest) or the most + adj (the most interesting).

questions.question: True or false: "This is the best pizza in town." is correct English.
questions.explanation: This sentence follows the target grammar.
